content: Ɔkátsiá Kana Wúlutɔ
Ɛkɛ sáásɩ́ a, betsiá ɔká Kana wúlu ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Galilea ɔmátɔ́. Yesu mʋ yin bʋ ɩnʋ.
Bɛtɩ Yesu mʋa mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ ɛ́ mʋ́ asɩ.
Brɛ́á amʋ́ ntá lɛta á, Yesu mʋ yin lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Bʋtráa bʋma ntá.”
Yesu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Amʋ́ yín, yɛ́ɛ megyí mɩ́ asʋ́n igyi o! Mɩ́ brɛ́ mɔkʋ́nyá fʋn.”
Mʋ yin lɛ́bláa wóyí ámʋtɔ asúmpʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩbwɛ dɩnka asʋ́ngyíasʋ́n ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́bláa mlɩsʋ.”
Yudafɔ bʋtɔfwɩ́ ɩwɩ amʋ́ amándɩ́ɛ́ ɔkpasʋ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔpʋ awʋndɩ akpɔnkpɔɔnkpɔntɩ asie yáɩ́ wóyí ámʋtɔ.
Yesu lɛ́bláa ɩnʋ asúmpʋ́ amʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩsa ntsu bʋla awʋndɩ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́.” Lɛ́lɛ́ bɛsa.
Ɩnʋ ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩsa ɩkʋ ya nkɛsʋ ɔkɩ́pʋ amʋ.” Bɛsa ya mʋ.
Ɔlɛda mʋ́ ɔnɔ́ á, ɩladámlí bwɛ́ ntá. Omeyín ɔtɩ́nɛ́á benya ntá ámʋ tsú. (Támɛ asúmpʋ́ amʋ mʋ́ bʋyin.) Ɩnʋ ɔlɛtɩ ɔká otsiápʋ amʋ ya ɩtsɛ́tɔ́,
ɔlɛbláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nta wankláán ɔhagyíɔha tegyankpá yáɩ́. Nɩ́ bonu mʋ́ tá asa bʋtɔpʋ́ mʋ́á ɩma alɛ ba. Támɛ fʋ́ mʋ́ fapʋ́ wankláán ámʋ yáɩ́ bɔfʋn séi.”
Ɩ́nɩ gyí osúna gyankpapʋ ánɩ́ Yesu lɔ́bwɛ nɩ́. Ɔlɔbwɛ mʋ́ Kana ánɩ́ ɩbʋ Galilea ɔmátɔ́, pʋ́lɛ́ mʋ numnyam ɔwan. Ɩlɛha mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɔhɔ mʋ gyi.
Ɩ́nɩ ɔma a, Yesu mʋa mʋ yin, mʋ apíó pʋ́ mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ bɔyɔ Kapernaum wúlutɔ, yétsiá ɩnʋ nkɛ kpalobí.
Yesu Bulu Ɔtswɛ́kpa Yɔ
Brɛ́á nkɛá Yudafɔ bɔ́pʋgyi Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ lowie wóyí tá á, Yesu lɔ́dʋ yɔ́ Yerusalem.
Ɔlɔyɔ Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ wunsɩnɛ́sʋ́ yówun ánɩ́ ahá bʋdɛ nnantswie, akúfa pʋ́ abrɔ́dʋma fɛ. Olowun akʋ ɛ́ bʋtsie mpʋ́nʋ́asɩ bʋdɛ kɔ́ba tsɛ́ɛ.
Ɩnʋ ɔlɔbwɛ mplɩ, wíé amʋ́tɔ́, gyáa amʋ́a mbwɩ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ dálɩ. Olowutá kɔ́ba atsɛ́pʋ amʋ mpʋ́nʋ́ dá, dá amʋ́ kɔ́ba sáɩ́n.
Mʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛbláa abrɔ́dʋma afɛpʋ́ ámʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩlɛ amʋ́ nfɩ! Mlɩmápʋ mɩ́ Sɩ́ wóyítɔ́ bwɛ́ mlɩ ibíá ogyíkpá.”
Ɩ́nɩá ɩlɛba alɩ sʋ á, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛkaɩ́n Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ anfɩsʋ. “Fʋ́ osúmkpá amʋ asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ igyi mɩ́ asʋnbogya.”
Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛba Yesu wá bɛfɩtɛ́ mʋ bɛɛ, “Osúna mɔmʋ fɔ́bwɛ pʋ́súná anɩ ánɩ́ Bulu túmitɔ fʋ́dɛ ɩ́nɩ bwɛ?”
Yesu lɛ́bláa amʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Mlɩbwie Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa anfɩ, nɔ́pʋ nkɛnsá yí mʋ́.”
Yudafɔ ahandɛ amʋ bɛbláa mʋ bɛɛ, “Nfí adʋana-sie kɛ́kɛ́ bɔpʋyi obu ánfɩ. Mʋ́ fʋ́ mʋ́ fɛɛ, fɔ́pʋ nkɛnsá yí mʋ́?”
Támɛ mʋ nyankpʋsa-oyí ɩwɩ asʋ́n ɔdɛblɩ́, megyí Bulu ɔtswɛ́kpa amʋ.
Brɛ́á Bulu lɔ́kʋsʋ́a mʋ tsú afúlitɔ ɔma a, mʋ akasɩ́pʋ́ amʋ bɛkaɩ́n ánɩ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ asʋ́n ánfɩ. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔhɔ Bulu asʋ́n pʋ́ Yesu asʋn blɩ́hɛ́ amʋsʋ gyi.
Yesu Yin Nyankpʋsa Klʋntɔ
Yesu lɔ́bwɛ osúna tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ Israelfɔsʋ Katsʋn Nkɛ ámʋtɔ brɛ́á ɔbʋ Yerusalem, ahá tsɔtsɔɔtsɔ bowun. Mʋ́ sʋ bɔhɔ mʋ gyi.
Támɛ Yesu mɔ́pʋ ansɩ́ dɩ́nká amʋ́sʋ́, tsúfɛ́ oyin alɩá amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́ bʋgyi.
Mehián ánɩ́ ɔhaa ɔbɛ́bláa mʋ ɔha ɩwɩ asʋ́n, tsúfɛ́ mʋ onutó oyin asʋ́n ánɩ́ ɩbʋ nyankpʋsa klʋntɔ.
